description: Set the stock level of one of the bound seller's product listings. Use this for inventory changes only; edit price, title or other fields with seller_update_listing. Pass `stock` for an absolute count or `delta` for a signed adjustment (if both are sent, `stock` wins). Returns the updated listing summary, including stock, stock_reserved and available_stock. Errors: product_not_found (not your listing), stock_negative, stock_below_reserved (units held by pending purchases cannot be removed), managed_externally (stock syncs from a connected platform such as Shopify).

delta.description: Signed adjustment applied to current stock (e.g. -2). Result cannot go below reserved stock.

product_id.description: UUID of the listing whose stock to change.

stock.description: Absolute new stock level in units. Provide either stock or delta, not both.

name: seller_update_stock
title: Seller update stock
